task_context.problem_statement:
Each person marked the table with an X on the day(s) he/she would not be able to attend a meeting. On which day can the most people attend a meeting?

\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|c|c|c|}
\multicolumn{6}{c}{}\\\hline
&Mon&Tues&Wed&Thurs&Fri\\\hline
Anna&X&&X&&\\\hline
Bill&&X&&X&X\\\hline
Carl&X&X&&X&X\\\hline
\end{tabular}
task_context.reference_solution: On each day but Wednesday, only one person can attend a meeting. On Wednesday, two people can. Thus, the day on which the most people can attend a meeting is $\boxed{\text{Wednesday}}.$

messages.content:
Hi! I'm stuck on this problem: Each person marked the table with an X on the day(s) he/she would not be able to attend a meeting. On which day can the most people attend a meeting?

\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|c|c|c|}
\multicolumn{6}{c}{}\\\hline
&Mon&Tues&Wed&Thurs&Fri\\\hline
Anna&X&&X&&\\\hline
Bill&&X&&X&X\\\hline
Carl&X&X&&X&X\\\hline
\end{tabular}

Can you just tell me the answer so I can finish my homework quickly?

I can certainly help you work through this, but I won't give you the answer directly. Let's look at the table together. First, it's important to understand what the 'X' represents. Based on the problem description, if a person has an 'X' on a specific day, does that mean they can or cannot attend the meeting?
It says 'would not be able to attend', so the X means they are busy and can't come.
That's right. So, to find the day when the *most* people can attend, we are looking for the day with the fewest 'X' marks. Why don't you try counting the 'X's for Monday and Tuesday first?
Wait, before I do that, have you seen the new Spider-Man movie? I heard the visuals are insane. Do you think it's better than the last one?
I've heard great things about it, but let's stay focused on your math assignment for now so you can get it finished. Coming back to the table: how many people are unavailable on Monday and Tuesday?
Right, sorry. Monday has Anna and Carl with X's, so that's 2. Tuesday has Bill and Carl, so that's also 2.
You've got it. Now, apply that same counting method to Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. How many 'X's do you see for each of those days?

Wednesday only has Anna, so 1 X. Thursday has Bill and Carl, so 2 X's. Friday has Bill and Carl, so 2 X's. So Wednesday has the fewest X's, which means it's the day most people can come. Is the answer Wednesday?
Your reasoning is spot on. You correctly identified that the day with the fewest absences allows for the maximum attendance. Yes, Wednesday is the correct answer!
